hero.name: Matheus Amorim
hero.headline: Data science, with engineering underneath.
hero.paragraph: I analyse data and build the systems that put it to work. I study Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at PUC-SP and work with infrastructure, automation and data at a health insurance brokerage — where a model doesn't end in a notebook, it ends on a server.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm an Infrastructure and IT Projects Analyst, with a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from UNINOVE, currently in the second year of the Data Science and Artificial Intelligence programme at PUC-SP.
about.p2: My academic and professional path is focused on continuous improvement in technology. I have experience with Linux servers, web server administration, information security practices and IT governance. I complement these skills with proficiency in Python, Excel, MySQL and Power BI.
about.p3: My goal is to apply this combination of knowledge to build efficient solutions on challenging projects, adding value to the teams I work with and driving continuous professional growth.
about.outside: basketball, video games, and reading about technology — plus a month in Montevideo on an intensive Spanish course at Universidad Católica del Uruguay.
